entities.name: Allied Plumbing Heating & Air Conditioning Ltd.

licences.scope: Install, alter, repair or maintain boilers and pressure vessels, and construct, install, repair, maintain or alter pressure piping systems, including refrigeration plant piping.
Install, alter, maintain or repair a refrigeration plant or system of 5 kW or more rating as listed on the prime mover or package unit nameplate.
Scope is set by the type and class of certificate of qualification held by the individual performing the regulated work — a gas contractor licence carries no class of its own.
